description: Defines data structures and classes for managing UE (User Equipment) context in a NRPP (NR Packet Processing Architecture) module, including context list management, timers, and logging.

classes.name: nrppa_ue_context
classes.description: Represents the context of a UE, including identifiers, timers, measurement quantities, and logger.

classes.name: nrppa_ue_context_list
classes.description: Manages a collection of UE contexts, providing methods to add, remove, and access UE contexts.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses the UE context by UE index.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE context to the list.

methods.name: update_ue_index
methods.description: Updates the UE index and notifier for an existing UE context.

methods.name: remove_ue_context
methods.description: Removes a UE context by UE index.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of UE contexts managed.

methods.name: allocate_ran_ue_meas_id
methods.description: Allocates the next available RAN UE measurement ID.
